messages:
maria: Cutoff in ~3h — final check. We need version bump merged, changelog PR, docs snippet, QA sign-off, and security quick sign. Please confirm ownership.
kevin: version bump PR is up: #4527 -> bumped to 0.22.3. needs one more approval for merge.
sophie: QA will run smoke + a quick regression matrix on staging once the canary is up. I'll queue now, ETA ~35m.
arjun: Can someone post the checklist we want run for smoke? small list so we can automate pass/fail.
maria: smoke list: 1) auth flows 2) hosted API latency sanity 3) canary model correctness (sample prompts) 4) batch inference throughput check. If all green -> promote.
kevin: changelog is in #4528 (draft) — highlights: batching fixes, kv cache perf, rollout config tweak.
jen: docs: added release fragment at /docs/releases/0.22.3.md, awaiting review. pinging @maria @kevin for accuracy.
docs-bot: docs lint OK for 0.22.3 fragment. link: https://internal.docs/release/0.22.3
security-bot: quick security scan completed: no new high/critical findings. low findings: dependency bump notice in parser. details: https://security/reports/1934
kevin: Approving PR now, will merge after CI passes. merging window is 20m from now so canary has time.
maria: Who's on call for canary monitoring? need eyeballs for the first 15 minutes post-merge.
sophie: I'll monitor metrics for first 20m, can set alert thresholds tighter temporarily.
arjun: Rollback plan (quick):
```
1) revert merge commit and re-deploy previous image
2) if revert fails -> manual cut of hotfix branch from previous tag and cherry-pick critical patches
3) notify incident channel + start postmortem doc
```
maria: Good — I'll own the revert if needed. @kevin please make sure the revert script is green: `scripts/revert_release.sh`.
kevin: running local dry-run now. If anything fails I'll post logs here.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated: release-0.22.3 -> canary pool. logs: https://deploys/1934567890
sophie: Canary metrics: latency p95 currently +12% vs baseline; CPU spiked briefly but stabilized. not blocking yet, continuing monitoring.
maria: QA found one minor regression in file upload that affects large files. creating ticket and setting severity to medium. ticket #5677.
kevin: I can patch small serializer bug quickly if QA confirms repro steps. ETA 25m.
jen: Docs note added about upload limit behavior to release notes (temporary workaround).
security-bot: added note: ensure KMS key rotation schedule unaffected by this release (checked)
arjun: ok we're within cutoff. If no blocker in next 20m we'll promote canary to prod. final roll call: @maria (release lead), @kevin (merge), @sophie (QA/monitor), @jen (docs), @security-bot (sec ok).
maria: ack :thumbsup: proceeding. will post final promote message when promoting.
kevin: CI passed, merging now.
deploy-bot: Merge completed, canary traffic at 5% for 10 minutes then 25%.
sophie: monitoring looks good, no new errors in the last 10m.
maria: promoting to 25% now.
jen: docs published to site.
arjun: after-promote checklist: update changelog anchor in release notes, tag repo, and notify sales/marketing.
maria: done. Notifying sales now.
kevin: great work team, thanks.
maria: closing thread; if anything pops up ping #incidents. :tada:
